```{r setup, include=FALSE}
source(here::here("scripts/R/functions/report_setup.R"))
setup_report(
  sources = c("02", "03"),
  packages = c("here", "ggplot2", "dplyr", "survival", "survminer", "cowplot"),
  set_theme = FALSE
)
```

```{r data-prep, include=FALSE}
# Complete cases for CRP and TMB/BRAF plots
data_complete <- data[complete.cases(data[, c(
  "Age", "sex", "Rx", "crp", "tmb_braf",
  "OSwk", "Death", "PFSwk", "Progression"
)]), ]

# Separate subset for TLR (post-treatment mediator — more NAs expected)
data_tlr <- data[complete.cases(data[, c(
  "Age", "sex", "Rx", "tlr",
  "OSwk", "Death", "PFSwk", "Progression"
)]), ]

# Treatment indicator: 0 = Control, 1 = Experimental
data_complete$Rx_num <- as.numeric(data_complete$Rx == "Experimental arm")
data_tlr$Rx_num      <- as.numeric(data_tlr$Rx      == "Experimental arm")

# Helper: create 4-level group factor (treatment x biomarker)
make_group <- function(rx_num, biomarker, pos_label, neg_label) {
  treated_label   <- ifelse(rx_num == 1, "Treated", "Untreated")
  biomarker_label <- ifelse(biomarker == 1, pos_label, neg_label)
  factor(
    paste0(treated_label, " / ", biomarker_label),
    levels = c(
      paste0("Treated / ",   pos_label),
      paste0("Treated / ",   neg_label),
      paste0("Untreated / ", pos_label),
      paste0("Untreated / ", neg_label)
    )
  )
}

# Create group variables for each biomarker
data_complete$grp_crp <- make_group(
  data_complete$Rx_num, data_complete$crp, "CRP+", "CRP-"
)
data_complete$grp_tmb <- make_group(
  data_complete$Rx_num, data_complete$tmb_braf, "TMB/BRAF+", "TMB/BRAF-"
)
data_tlr$grp_tlr <- make_group(
  data_tlr$Rx_num, data_tlr$tlr, "TLR+", "TLR-"
)

# Week-9 landmark cohorts for TLR. TLR (tumour lesion reduction) is a
# post-randomization response measured at the first on-treatment assessment,
# so plotting it from randomization would introduce guarantee-time bias. The
# landmark analysis (i) fixes the landmark at week 9, (ii) restricts to
# patients still at risk at the landmark, and (iii) resets the clock so t = 0
# is the landmark. At-risk sets are endpoint-specific: the OS cohort is alive
# at week 9; the PFS cohort is alive and progression-free at week 9. Mirrors
# the landmark methodology in clinical_effectiveness.qmd.
LANDMARK_WK <- 9

data_tlr_lm_os  <- data_tlr[data_tlr$OSwk  >= LANDMARK_WK, ]
data_tlr_lm_os$OSwk_lm   <- data_tlr_lm_os$OSwk  - LANDMARK_WK

data_tlr_lm_pfs <- data_tlr[data_tlr$PFSwk >= LANDMARK_WK, ]
data_tlr_lm_pfs$PFSwk_lm <- data_tlr_lm_pfs$PFSwk - LANDMARK_WK

# Shared palette and linetypes
km_palette   <- c("#B2182B", "#F4A582", "#2166AC", "#92C5DE")
km_linetypes <- c("solid", "dashed", "solid", "dashed")

km_theme <- theme_minimal() + theme(
  axis.title       = element_text(size = 10),
  axis.text        = element_text(size = 9),
  legend.title     = element_blank(),
  legend.text      = element_text(size = 8),
  legend.position  = "bottom",
  legend.key.width = unit(1.5, "lines")
)
```

```{r km-plots, include=FALSE}
# Build one KM plot (no title, no p-value)
# time_col/event_col/group_col are column names in data so ggsurvplot can
# resolve the formula internally
km_plot <- function(data, time_col, event_col, group_col,
                    show_xlab = TRUE, show_ylab = TRUE, tag = NULL,
                    xlab_text = "Time (weeks)") {
  # Keep only group levels actually present (e.g. after a landmark
  # restriction), preserving the fixed colour/linetype mapping per level.
  full_lvls <- levels(data[[group_col]])
  present   <- full_lvls[full_lvls %in% unique(as.character(data[[group_col]]))]
  idx       <- match(present, full_lvls)

  formula <- as.formula(paste0("Surv(", time_col, ", ", event_col, ") ~ ", group_col))
  km_fit  <- eval(bquote(survfit(.(formula), data = data)))

  sp <- ggsurvplot(
    km_fit, data = data,
    pval        = FALSE, conf.int = FALSE,
    palette     = km_palette[idx],
    linetype    = km_linetypes[idx],
    legend      = "bottom",
    legend.labs = present,
    xlab        = if (show_xlab) xlab_text else "",
    ylab        = if (show_ylab) "Survival probability" else "",
    ggtheme     = km_theme,
    font.x      = 10,
    font.y      = 10,
    font.tickslab = 9
  )

  p <- sp$plot

  # Suppress axis titles when not needed
  if (!show_xlab) p <- p + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
  if (!show_ylab) p <- p + theme(axis.title.y = element_blank())

  # Subplot tag (e.g. "a)") in top-left corner
  if (!is.null(tag)) {
    p <- p + labs(tag = tag) +
      theme(
        plot.tag          = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
        plot.tag.position = "topleft"
      )
  }

  p
}

# Column order: OS (left), PFS (right). Row order: CRP, TMB/BRAF, TLR.
# Only the left column shows the y-axis title; only the bottom row shows the
# x-axis title.

# Row 1 — CRP  (week-4 value, before first nivolumab dose; clock from randomization)
p_os_crp  <- km_plot(data_complete, "OSwk",  "Death",       "grp_crp",
                     show_xlab = FALSE, show_ylab = TRUE,  tag = "a)")
p_pfs_crp <- km_plot(data_complete, "PFSwk", "Progression", "grp_crp",
                     show_xlab = FALSE, show_ylab = FALSE, tag = "b)")

# Row 2 — TMB/BRAF  (baseline biomarker, clock from randomization)
p_os_tmb  <- km_plot(data_complete, "OSwk",  "Death",       "grp_tmb",
                     show_xlab = FALSE, show_ylab = TRUE,  tag = "c)")
p_pfs_tmb <- km_plot(data_complete, "PFSwk", "Progression", "grp_tmb",
                     show_xlab = FALSE, show_ylab = FALSE, tag = "d)")

# Row 3 — TLR  (post-randomization response; week-9 landmark, clock reset)
p_os_tlr  <- km_plot(data_tlr_lm_os,  "OSwk_lm",  "Death",       "grp_tlr",
                     show_xlab = TRUE,  show_ylab = TRUE,  tag = "e)",
                     xlab_text = "Time since week-9 landmark (weeks)")
p_pfs_tlr <- km_plot(data_tlr_lm_pfs, "PFSwk_lm", "Progression", "grp_tlr",
                     show_xlab = TRUE,  show_ylab = FALSE, tag = "f)",
                     xlab_text = "Time since week-9 landmark (weeks)")
```

```{r panel, fig.width=14, fig.height=17}
#| fig-cap: "Kaplan-Meier survival by biomarker status and treatment arm. Columns: overall survival (left) and progression-free survival (right). Rows: CRP (week-4 value, measured before the first nivolumab dose after two FLOX cycles common to both arms) and TMB/BRAF (baseline), both with follow-up measured from randomization, and TLR (tumour lesion reduction, a post-randomization response shown on the week-9 landmark cohort with follow-up measured from the landmark). Within each panel, curves are stratified by treatment arm and biomarker status (Treated/Untreated x positive/negative); for TLR the treatment split is descriptive because response is measured after randomization. CRP-positive = CRP < 5 mg/L; TMB/BRAF-positive = TMB >= 9 mut/Mb or BRAF mutation; TLR-positive = tumour lesion reduction at the first on-treatment CT."

# Column and row label grobs
col_os  <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Overall Survival",
                                 fontface = "bold", size = 13)
col_pfs <- ggdraw() + draw_label("Progression-Free Survival",
                                 fontface = "bold", size = 13)
row_crp <- ggdraw() + draw_label("CRP",
                                 fontface = "bold", size = 13, angle = 90)
row_tmb <- ggdraw() + draw_label("TMB/BRAF",
                                 fontface = "bold", size = 13, angle = 90)
row_tlr <- ggdraw() + draw_label("TLR (week-9 landmark)",
                                 fontface = "bold", size = 13, angle = 90)

# Assemble: thin left column for row labels, thin top row for column labels
header <- plot_grid(NULL, col_os, col_pfs,
                    ncol = 3, rel_widths = c(0.08, 1, 1))
row1   <- plot_grid(row_crp, p_os_crp, p_pfs_crp,
                    ncol = 3, rel_widths = c(0.08, 1, 1))
row2   <- plot_grid(row_tmb, p_os_tmb, p_pfs_tmb,
                    ncol = 3, rel_widths = c(0.08, 1, 1))
row3   <- plot_grid(row_tlr, p_os_tlr, p_pfs_tlr,
                    ncol = 3, rel_widths = c(0.08, 1, 1))

p <- plot_grid(header, row1, row2, row3,
               ncol = 1, rel_heights = c(0.05, 1, 1, 1))
p
```

```{r save-figure, include=FALSE}
figs_dir <- here("figs")
if (!dir.exists(figs_dir)) dir.create(figs_dir, recursive = TRUE)

ggsave(
  filename = here("figs", "clin_effect_figure1.png"),
  plot     = p,
  width    = 14, height = 17, dpi = 300, bg = "white"
)
cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "clin_effect_figure1.png"), "\n")

# Vector EPS for publication (solid/dashed lines only, no transparency, so the
# classic PostScript device gives a clean, fully editable EPS).
ggsave(
  filename = here("figs", "clin_effect_figure1.eps"),
  plot     = p,
  width    = 14, height = 17, device = "eps", bg = "white"
)
cat("Figure saved to:", here("figs", "clin_effect_figure1.eps"), "\n")
```

Figure saved to `figs/clin_effect_figure1.png` and `figs/clin_effect_figure1.eps`.
